mainEntity.name: How do I ensure quality in the final detail work?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure quality in final detail work, regular communication with your contractor is key. Participate actively in punch list walkthroughs, clearly documenting any concerns. Review completed items thoroughly. A reputable contractor will have their own quality control processes in place and will be responsive to your feedback, aiming for a high standard of finish.
